integrity: The algebraic sign comparison is separated from the source's finite-time numerical Lyapunov estimates. Exact symbolic identities are reproduced by a dependency-free checker; no claim of independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the five-dimensional vector field exactly as printed in Eq. (2) with \(d>0\) and compact invariant dynamics. It does not rule out ordinary chaos, classify global attractors, or validate the plus-sign variant numerically.
title: A sign mismatch flips the transverse Lyapunov spectrum of a 5D Sprott-C extension
